A_direct_model_to_signal.why: violates Signal S-1 because one record is one observation; puts model output one step from Evidence; several findings from one text would read as several witnesses; derivation_confidence would carry a number nobody calibrated

B_model_to_validated_observation_to_dete.why: the model returns quotes and closed-enum types only; a model-free validator computes offsets against a recomputed surface and refuses on any mismatch; the artifact is non-canonical; only a later deterministic builder over two or more records may produce a Signal

C_model_to_candidate_to_human_promotion_.why: a promoted candidate is still one observation, so promotion does not make it a Signal; a durable candidate registry is Claims before Claims (ADR-038); human judgement is kept in evaluation, not in the write path

selected_architecture.flow: held NormalizedRecord -> text surface (deterministic) -> [future: four gates, prompt, forced strict tool] -> model payload -> deterministic validator -> non-canonical validated extraction -> [future N08-C: deterministic count builder over two or more records]

packages.contract: packages/semantic-extraction-contract (sros_semantic_extraction_contract): standard library and sros-contracts only; surface, labels, validator, fingerprints; no prompt, no model, no network, no persistence
packages.future_extractor: packages/semantic-extraction (N08-B): the contract plus sros-llm-gateway only; prompt, strict-tool projection, authorization before serialization; must not depend on sros-acquisition or sros-nlp; sros_nlp must be forbidden from importing it

validated_extraction.extraction_id: sha256 over lineage and provenance, model and prompt included, outputs excluded
finding: finding_id: sha256 over extraction_id, type, evidence span and subject span
evidence_start and evidence_end, computed by the validator
does_not_establish: the contract constant, never from the model

extraction_schema.refusal_policy: every check runs; any refusal rejects the whole extraction; a refusal is never an abstention and never a zero-finding answer; a schema failure is logged as possible injection, retried at most once, never falls back to another provider

labels.definition: The asker states, in their own words, that they tried a specific approach and it did not work: an error, a wrong result, or no effect. A question that only asks how to do something, with no attempt reported as failing, is not this label. A failed workaround is this label.
does_not_establish: that the problem recurs, or that any other record states the same problem
how many people are affected, severity, or pain
demand, willingness to pay, purchase intent or a market
that the asker's statement is true
independence from any other finding
that the tool or approach tried is inadequate (SOLUTION_GAP)
dissatisfaction with any solution

labels.definition: The asker states, in their own words and outside code or quoted material, a negative evaluation of a solution named in the text (a tool, library, service or product), not merely that it produced an error. Asking why a tool behaves a certain way is not an evaluation.
does_not_establish: that the problem recurs, or that any other record states the same problem
how many people are affected, severity, or pain
demand, willingness to pay, purchase intent or a market
that the asker's statement is true
independence from any other finding
that the asker would switch
that the complaint is representative of any population
which canonical subject the named solution is (held as a verbatim string only)

labels.definition: The asker states that an alternative approach they used does work.
does_not_establish: that the problem recurs, or that any other record states the same problem
how many people are affected, severity, or pain
demand, willingness to pay, purchase intent or a market
that the asker's statement is true
independence from any other finding
SOLUTION_GAP: a working workaround is evidence that a solution exists
labels.blocker: whether a burdensome but working workaround bears on PROBLEM_OR_NEED is undecided

labels.definition: The asker asks that a named tool add a capability it is stated to lack.
does_not_establish: that the problem recurs, or that any other record states the same problem
how many people are affected, severity, or pain
demand, willingness to pay, purchase intent or a market
that the asker's statement is true
independence from any other finding
that the capability does not already exist
labels.blocker: 'is there a way to' is the ordinary question form on this site; incidence is measured first

labels.definition: The asker states that the same difficulty happens to them repeatedly.
does_not_establish: that the problem recurs, or that any other record states the same problem
how many people are affected, severity, or pain
demand, willingness to pay, purchase intent or a market
that the asker's statement is true
independence from any other finding
labels.blocker: RECURRENCE_OR_FREQUENCY was written for recurrence across observations, not one author

labels.definition: The asker states an intention to replace one named solution with another.
does_not_establish: that the problem recurs, or that any other record states the same problem
how many people are affected, severity, or pain
demand, willingness to pay, purchase intent or a market
that the asker's statement is true
independence from any other finding
labels.blocker: no dimension asks about switching; SOLUTION_DISSATISFACTION never means that they would switch

labels.definition: The asker states they would pay for something.
does_not_establish: that the problem recurs, or that any other record states the same problem
how many people are affected, severity, or pain
demand, willingness to pay, purchase intent or a market
that the asker's statement is true
independence from any other finding
that anyone paid or committed to pay (WILLINGNESS_TO_PAY)
labels.blocker: WILLINGNESS_TO_PAY asks whether an actor paid or committed to pay; a hypothetical is neither

labels.definition: The asker states they paid for a named product or service.
does_not_establish: that the problem recurs, or that any other record states the same problem
how many people are affected, severity, or pain
demand, willingness to pay, purchase intent or a market
that the asker's statement is true
independence from any other finding
a verified transaction, an amount or a price
labels.blocker: whether an unidentified actor's self-report counts as 'paid', and linking it to a need (G7)

labels.definition: A statement that no solution exists.
does_not_establish: that the problem recurs, or that any other record states the same problem
how many people are affected, severity, or pain
demand, willingness to pay, purchase intent or a market
that the asker's statement is true
independence from any other finding
labels.blocker: SOLUTION_GAP never means that absence of evidence of a solution is evidence of its absence

excluded_candidate.label: PROBLEM_STATEMENT
excluded_candidate.why: on Stack Overflow every question states being stuck by site design, and community_question_volume already maps to PROBLEM_OR_NEED deterministically; a near-constant label separates nothing

prohibited_inferences.never: importance, market size or willingness to pay
a product category or the subject of a finding

prohibited_inferences.from: two findings from one record, or re-runs, or different models
an error message containing emotional words
text inside a quote, a pasted issue or code

persistence_boundary.n08a: nothing persisted; the validator returns an in-memory object
persistence_boundary.stage_1_non_canonical_artifact: minimal later schema, not created: nlp.semantic_record_extractions (one row per extraction identity, state CHECK, provenance NOT NULL, RLS) and nlp.semantic_findings (spans with CHECK 0 <= start < end, parent state FINDINGS_PRESENT); no foreign key from research.claims or scoring.evidence; the writer lives outside sros_nlp
persistence_boundary.stage_2_signal: a Signal only from a deterministic builder over validated findings from two or more distinct observation_keys; requires an ADR for the quantity family (COMMUNITY_QUESTION_VOLUME is scoped to a site's own tag vocabulary), a truthful derivation_confidence semantics for MODEL_DERIVED, and a provider column
persistence_boundary.human_promotion: not in the write path for the two EXTRACTABLE labels; human judgement is used for reference labels and adjudication; any BLOCKED label later unblocked must state whether it needs human promotion

source_lineage_rules: every finding carries the normalized_record_id and observation_key of exactly one held record
the surface is recomputed from the held record and its digest must equal the digest the prompt was built from
a finding cites a span of the surface, never a tag, score, view count or answer metadata
the source observation and the model interpretation stay separately addressable; the NormalizedRecord is never modified
attribution (Stack Exchange Network, CC BY-SA 4.0, item link) travels with any derived artifact that is displayed
independence_inheritance_rules_for_n06: all findings from one normalized record inherit that record's single observation lineage: one witness
multiple findings from one question are not independent evidence
model re-runs are not independent evidence
different models interpreting the same question are not independent evidence
one prompt and model across many records is a shared interpretive cause, recorded and never assumed away

prompt_injection_boundary.source_text: UNTRUSTED DATA: one UntrustedText region per surface, delimiter-neutralised
prompt_injection_boundary.gate_order: the four ADR-033 gates are resolved before any string containing source text exists
prompt_injection_boundary.tools: one forced strict tool; no browsing, no execution, no other tools
prompt_injection_boundary.what_an_injection_can_reach: choosing an enum value or a quote that must already exist in the source; the validator, not the model, decides offsets, labels and lineage
prompt_injection_boundary.residual: an injected but verbatim quote with a wrong label passes the validator and is caught only by human evaluation (fixture prompt_injection_text)

annotation.extractable_labels: PRESENT requires at least one verbatim evidence span of the surface; NEGATIVE_EVALUATION_OF_NAMED_SOLUTION also requires a verbatim subject; UNCERTAIN requires a note
annotation.incidence_labels: ANNOTATION_ONLY and BLOCKED labels are marked PRESENT, ABSENT or UNCERTAIN without spans, to measure incidence only
annotation.holder_rule: only the asker's own first-person statements count; quoted, attributed, negated or hypothetical text is ABSENT
annotation.multi_label: labels are independent; no label implies another
annotation.origin: reference_origin is required and one of HUMAN_OPERATOR, HUMAN_EXPERT, HUMAN_NON_EXPERT; AI_ASSISTED_PROVISIONAL is refused for this dataset

evaluation_protocol.annotators: at least two humans on separate blank copies, blind to each other and to any model output, with a deterministic per-annotator shuffle
evaluation_protocol.agreement: Cohen's kappa per extractable label (Krippendorff's alpha for more than two), plus positive-specific agreement and raw counts, because prevalence is extreme
evaluation_protocol.adjudication: a third human or a recorded joint session; both original labels kept; unresolved stays UNCERTAIN; adjudication never consults model output
evaluation_protocol.gold: a label is gold for a split only when agreement meets the accepted floor and the composition gate passes; otherwise LABEL_NOT_RELIABLY_ANNOTATABLE or REFERENCE_SET_INSUFFICIENT, never fixed by moving records, relabelling or widening a definition
metrics: precision, recall and F1 on PRESENT per label per split, with Clopper-Pearson intervals, descriptive and never a pass condition alone
abstention quality: abstain rate on gold UNCERTAIN and on gold-decided records
unsupported-assertion rate: mechanical (validator refusal) and semantic (a human judges the span does not support the label), reported apart
span correctness: exact and overlap; subject exact match
deterministic schema validity: refusals counted as failures, not abstentions
run-to-run consistency over three pinned runs; run 1 is the scored run
cost and latency, recorded and never treated as quality
evaluation_protocol.constant_classifier_defeat: the criterion is computed so that all-ABSENT, all-PRESENT and all-ABSTAIN classifiers each fail against the frozen gold counts

proposed_thresholds.derivation: A false PRESENT manufactures a business problem that can travel to a Signal and a Claim, while a false ABSENT loses one observation. Thresholds therefore cap false PRESENT with an upper confidence bound and tolerate conservative misses. With zero false PRESENT among n PRESENT predictions the 95% upper bound is about 3/n, so certifying a rate r_max needs n >= 3/r_max PRESENT predictions in the scored split.

items.label: NEGATIVE_EVALUATION_OF_NAMED_SOLUTION
items.why: writes to SOLUTION_DISSATISFACTION, a counting dimension no held evidence reaches today

items.label: REPORTED_FAILED_ATTEMPT
items.why: lands on PROBLEM_OR_NEED, already held deterministically, so a false positive adds less new exposure
the validator refuses them by construction; an accepted one is a validator defect
refusals are failures; a model that cannot produce valid payloads is not usable
abstention is benign but must not replace answering
a result that changes on re-run cannot be audited
a conventional substantial-agreement floor; below it the label definition, not the model, is the problem
descriptive only; conservative misses are tolerated, but true PRESENT >= 1 is required
fixed in the future execution packet from priced token bounds, never estimated here

proposed_thresholds.sufficiency_projection: The holdout holds 48 records. Certifying 0.10 for NEGATIVE_EVALUATION_OF_NAMED_SOLUTION needs about 30 PRESENT predictions, which a 48-record Stack Overflow holdout is unlikely to contain. The preregistered response is EVALUATION_INSUFFICIENT for that label and a separately authorised, preregistered supplementary acquisition, never a lowered threshold.

future_provider_egress_requirements.source_permission: stack-exchange, local-private-research-v1, review v2: external_model_transmission PERMITTED_WITH_CONDITIONS (provider must commit to no training and bounded documented retention; inference only). The held records were normalized under review v1; a future run must confirm the v2 conditions verify as satisfied at run time.
future_provider_egress_requirements.provider_permission: model-provider-policy-v1.json: anthropic API-key route APPROVED on documents retrieved 2026-09-02 (review interval 180 days); subscription route NOT_APPROVED; gemini unpaid route NOT_APPROVED. Requalification is a required future step: the runtime does not check review age, so the future mission re-verifies route, endpoint, model, no-training and retention documents and records it. Nothing is approved from memory.
future_provider_egress_requirements.operator_approval: a packet-scoped approval naming packet id, version and recomputed sha256; the exact question_id set; representation schema and field allowlist; truncation limit; residual-identifier policy; prompt and rubric ids and digests; provider, route, endpoint, model and policy version; max calls, token bounds, USD ceiling and retry policy; exclusions (no training, fine-tuning, embeddings, publication, other site or source); output storage and retention.
may_leave: the rendered text surface of an included record
never_leaves: credentials, local paths and operator identity
future_provider_egress_requirements.residual_personal_information: Acquisition removed structured owner objects only; body text can still carry emails, user home paths, IP addresses, handles and pasted tokens. The frozen manifest records per-record counts of such patterns, never the text. Preferred policy: exclude or individually review flagged records rather than redact, because redaction changes the surface a span must cite. If redaction is chosen it must be deterministic, versioned, part of the surface version and part of the packet digest.
retention_and_training_controls: contractual no-training on the exact route
no retention-altering feature (batch, file storage) unless separately assessed
an explicit operator decision on zero retention
open questions to re-verify: trust-and-safety retention and human review
logging: gateway telemetry carries ids, tokens and cost only
correlation ids and task names never embed question text
provider error bodies must not echo prompt content into logs (to verify in N08-B)
stored model payloads contain verbatim quotes and stay local
future_provider_egress_requirements.local_model_route: Removes the transmission, profile-egress and provider-posture gates and the third-party retention question. Keeps the model_processing conditions, attribution, operator approval, evaluation, prompt-injection handling and personal data in stored outputs. Adds the weights licence for commercial-purpose use. Requires a local adapter, a policy posture and proof that the route is local. It does not remove the need for human reference labels.

N08-B: human labelling of the development pack by at least two annotators, adjudication, agreement and composition verdicts
operator acceptance or revision of the proposed thresholds
operator decision on the NLP_EXTRACTION and D-12 wording (re-ground it, or keep it blocked and run extraction outside the planner)
packages/semantic-extraction: prompt regions, strict-tool projection, authorization before serialization, and the sros_nlp import ban extended to it
egress packet: residual-identifier policy, provider requalification, packet-scoped operator approval
at most one bounded development run under that approval, with nothing persisted
N08-C: holdout labelling and one preregistered holdout run
a verdict per label: PASS, FAIL or EVALUATION_INSUFFICIENT
only on PASS: ADR and migration for the non-canonical staging tables
ADR for a count Signal over validated findings (quantity family, truthful derivation_confidence, provider column) and the INFERRED claim path
record the independence inheritance invariants in N06
no Opportunity, no score, no V11
